# Agent Python Tools

- repo: microsoft/playwright-python
- repo_uri: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-python

## File: microsoft_playwright-python/playwright/async_api/_generated.py

Prompts

```
['test the Page.goto method to navigate to a URL with optional wait_until and timeout parameters', 'test the Locator.click method to click an element with modifiers, position, button, and timeout options', 'test the BrowserType.launch method to launch a browser with headless, proxy, and slow_mo configuration', 'test the Locator.fill method to fill an input field with a value and optional force timeout options', 'test the LocatorAssertions.to_be_visible assertion to verify an element is attached and visible in the viewport']
```

Usage

```
{'test_page_navigate': 'test the Page.goto method to navigate to a URL with optional wait_until and timeout parameters', 'test_locator_click': 'test the Locator.click method to click an element with modifiers, position, button, and timeout options', 'test_browser_launch': 'test the BrowserType.launch method to launch a browser with headless, proxy, and slow_mo configuration', 'test_locator_fill': 'test the Locator.fill method to fill an input field with a value and optional force timeout options', 'test_locator_visible': 'test the LocatorAssertions.to_be_visible assertion to verify an element is attached and visible in the viewport'}
```
